review_locator: PMCID:PMC9687629, Regulation of CD4 T Cell Responses by the Transcription Factor Eomesodermin
primary_title: Eomesodermin promotes interferon-gamma expression and binds to multiple conserved noncoding sequences across the Ifng locus in mouse thymoma cell lines
decision_basis: The review identifies Eomes as a direct regulator of IFNG; the cited primary demonstrates Eomes-dependent Ifng promoter activation, Eomes occupancy at the Ifng promoter/CNS-22 and permissive histone modification changes.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the Eomes-associated Ifng gene-regulation bridge in the tested mouse thymoma-cell context. Preserve ectopic-expression and stimulation limits; do not infer IFN-gamma secretion, IFNGR signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7606821, The transcription factor Bhlhe40 in immunity and autoimmunity
primary_title: Bhlhe40 is an essential repressor of IL-10 during Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection
decision_basis: The review identifies BHLHE40 as a direct Il10-locus repressor; the cited primary shows Bhlhe40 binding at a conserved +6-kb Il10 enhancer and increased Il10 expression after Bhlhe40 loss in T-cell and myeloid contexts.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the BHLHE40-dependent Il10 enhancer-repression bridge in the tested mouse infection and immune-cell contexts. Preserve the +6-kb enhancer, cell-type and infection boundaries; do not infer IL-10 protein secretion, IL10R signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC2655130, Transcriptional regulation of IL-2 in health and autoimmunity
primary_title: FOXP3 controls regulatory T cell function through cooperation with NFAT
decision_basis: The review identifies a cooperative NFAT–FOXP3 complex at the IL2 promoter; the cited primary demonstrates FOXP3/NFAT cooperation, IL2 promoter repression, structure-guided FOXP3 interaction mutants and Treg functional consequences.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the cooperative NFAT1–FOXP3 IL2 promoter-repression bridge. Preserve TCR-activation, Treg and cooperative-complex context; do not split the result into unsupported unary NFAT1 or FOXP3 sufficiency, and do not infer IL-2 protein/IL2R signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7264322, Transcriptional and epigenetic basis of Treg cell development and function
primary_title: FOXP3 inhibits activation-induced NFAT2 expression in T cells thereby limiting effector cytokine expression
decision_basis: The review identifies NFAT2/NFATC2 as an early FOXP3-repressed transcriptional target; the cited primary demonstrates FOXP3-dependent suppression of the NFAT2 promoter, reduced NFAT2 in activated FOXP3-positive Tregs and competitive FOXP3/NFAT1 promoter occupancy.
limitations_preserved: Promote only the FOXP3-dependent NFATC2 gene-repression bridge in activated human T-cell/Treg contexts. Preserve the NFAT2 synonym for NFATC2 and competitive promoter-occupancy mechanism; do not infer global NFAT suppression, IL-2 protein/IL2R signaling, SCI effects or terminal-TF effects automatically.
